latest_release.name: v4.54.3
latest_release.body:
- Fixed preservation of YAML aliases across documents within the same input stream, without leaking anchors between files (#2956) Thanks @ingydotnet
  - Restricted `--split-exp` output paths to the current directory by default. Use `--security-allow-write-any-path` with trusted input to restore the previous behaviour (#2965)
  - Fixed `--inplace` to reject direct updates to read-only files and replace symbolic links instead of modifying their targets.  (#2973)
